title: SPA-VL: A Comprehensive Safety Preference Alignment Dataset for Vision Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures harmful content, including unfairness related to religion as one of its subcategories.
findings: The paper does not provide specific findings for the religion subcategory. Findings are aggregated across all harm types, showing that models trained on the proposed SPA-VL dataset achieve superior safety performance and are more harmless compared to baseline models.
